channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Oct 12
item.description:
135 development commits

Audio & Animal Interaction

  • Lingering sounds from destroyed monuments no longer persist after loading.
  • Sheep and cows now have richer interactions: new footstep and head‑shake sound cues, plus petting reactions with moo/baa sounds and scratch gestures.

Controls

  • Gamepad input handling refined: inactive sticks ignored to prevent drift, and duck‑latching logic fixed to stop escape‑menu input clearing issues.

Combat & Targeting

  • Hidden players now rank behind visible players in targeting, but can still be selected if no visible targets exist.
  • Patrol boats no longer abandon targets above sea level, fixing altitude targeting bug.
  • First‑person laser weapons now function correctly.

Vehicles & Boats

  • Player boat privileges restored when using the privilege cache.

Crafting & Items

  • Halloween DLC items fixed: lights are craftable with correct stack size and cost, and alien suit armor fits correctly.
  • Weapon drop behavior improved: mag drop system unified with glass AK implementation and unnecessary cachedPostIK removed.

Environment & Structures

  • Triangle spiral stairs now include an upkeep component, ensuring proper decay handling.
  • Arctic biome refrigeration now requires at least 10% biome presence, preventing unintended refrigeration in minimal arctic areas.
  • Explosives attached to solar panels now scale correctly, preserving size and functionality.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 11
item.description:
30 development commits

Structures

  • Chainlink gates now open at normal speed instead of being twice as slow.

Cosmetics

  • Spraycan reskin now correctly applies the chosen material on low‑quality double doors.

Vehicles & Mounts

  • Vehicle mount points can now be sized and overlapped, allowing a large flatbed mount to replace two small mounts; you can still load two sheep but not two cows.

Livestock & Farming

  • Livestock will now eat from troughs even when grass is present, and the amount of grass reduces the food value they receive.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Terrain configs now load correctly in the demo, preventing missing or broken terrain for players.
  • Building privilege checks are now cached, cutting the check time from ~4.6 ms to ~0.5 ms in large bases, reducing building lag.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 10
item.description:
13 development commits

Resources & Farming

  • Apples now spawn exactly at the location of their loot container on trees, changing where they can be collected.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Fixed laserbeam job processing to correctly use current materials, preventing resource loss and ensuring builds function as intended.
